Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREIn this bundleFINAL FANTASY RESONANCEView gameDescriptionPre-order Bonus: Magitek Airship & Squire Starter Pack This set contains an item that transforms your airship’s appearance into a magitek vessel, along with useful items to aid you at the start of your journey. Pack Contents: • Magitek Airship Passkey x1 • Knight’s Greatsword x1 • Chestplate of Preparation x1 (Increases EXP gained in battle by a certain amount) • Magicite Shard x1 • Tent x3 • Mist Potion x3 *These bonuses are available only to customers who pre-order the product and are not available to customers who purchase the product after release. *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. *The airship’s appearance can be changed by turning the Magitek Airship Passkey “ON” under the Items section of the main menu. --------------------- Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. ◆ Cinematic pixel art What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive. ◆ A return to the familiar A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more. ◆ Strategic turn-based battles Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices. ◆ FINAL FANTASY legends Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization. ◆ Hours of side content to discover The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon. --------------------- Early Purchase Bonus: Squire Kickstart Pack This set contains useful items to aid you at the start of your journey. Pack Contents: • Blessed Cuirass x1 (Increase gil obtained by a certain amount) • Mist Ether x1 *These bonuses are available only to customers who purchase the product by November 5, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. local time. *After progressing past a certain point in the game, you may claim the items from the postbox in front of the inn in the Town of Mitra. Learn moreGame requires online multiplayer subscription to play on console (Game Pass Core or Ultimate, sold separately).DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionOn an expedition to save your fellow Explorers, you and your partner become trapped beneath the ice of Antarctica. When you awaken, you find yourselves inside the mysterious Norček Industries facility with little recollection of what happened. Director Kathleen Bowe needs your help to continue the work of her missing research team before a global crisis unfolds. COMMUNICATE AND COOPERATE Often separated, rely on your walkie-talkies to share what you see, combine your perspectives, and solve asymmetrical puzzles together. TWO EXPLORERS, TWO ROLES Each player has a unique role, with different tools and information needed to overcome obstacles that neither of you could face alone. EXPLORE THE FUTURE AS IMAGINED BY THE 80S Discover Norček Industries, a retro-futuristic facility filled with strange technology, hidden secrets, and a nostalgic synthwave soundtrack. UNCOVER THE TRUTH The deeper you venture into Norček Industries, the more questions begin to surface. Why were you brought here? And what happened to those who came before you?
